items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: I have not found a teacher of this particular type of hybrid music, but have certainly found sympathetic people in music who are making efforts along these same lines; such people as Peggy Glanville-Hicks, David Broekman, Henry Brant, William Schuman, and many more.

ctx.x: I also have one commercial recording to my credit which features my quintet and four of my original compositions. This is on the Debut label and came out this year. I have also within the past year appeared on several radio shows presenting some of my compositions. These were on W.O.V. and the most recent on W.N.Y.C. on their Adventures In Music program August 1954. At this time I am also negotiating with one of the large record companies to record several of my new compositions. All of this I believe has helped…

I have not found a teacher of this particular type of hybrid music, but have certainly found sympathetic people in music who are making efforts along these same lines; such people as Peggy Glanville-Hicks, David Broekman, Henry Brant, William Schuman, and many more.
